name: crosstabs
description: Use 33 deterministic project-workflow tools and 40 statistics-server tools locally from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Auditable survey crosstabs and statistical tests
interface.longDescription: Run categorical and survey research with two local stdio MCP servers. The source release provides 33 headless workflow tools and 40 statistics-server tools (39 analytical tools plus runtime status), including portable revision-bound analysis plans, project handoff, approved dictionary edits, guarded transformations, design-aware methods, reports, and audit history. Respondent files and project state stay on the user's device.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this survey file and build evidence-linked crosstabs.
Create a weighted tab book, define the approved survey design, and export an editable report pack.
Choose the right test for this contingency table and explain assumptions.
